what_this_is: a PRE-REGISTERED prediction. Written before kickoff, committed before kickoff, and never edited afterwards. Its whole value is that it cannot be revised once the results are known
what_this_is_NOT: not an edge claim, not a recommendation, and not a reason to bet. One slate settles nothing

the_rule.statement: back the HOME side; among those, buy the ones the crowd is already drifting toward
the_rule.provenance: RECONSTRUCTED from the record on 2026-08-07, not stated anywhere at the time. Two facts fix it: every one of the 23 Leagues Cup journal rows ever recorded is `home_win`, and the four positions locked at 10:51:49Z on 2026-08-06 are exactly the four named 25 minutes earlier as already drifting home (Chicago +.022, NYCFC +.019, Portland +.018, America +.014), while the two named flat-or-against (Cruz Azul, Austin) sat untouched for 13 hours
the_rule.win_condition: the home side wins in 90 minutes. A draw is a LOSS

drift_measurement.quantity: de-vigged home points share, draws at half weight — the same quantity the read expresses
drift_measurement.note_on_the_frame: this metric is DEFINED on home share, so it can only ever name a home side. The all-home shape of any selection it produces is baked into the coordinate system, not discovered in the data

what_the_rule_selects_tonight.fixture: Tigres UANL v Minnesota United FC

the_filter_does_no_work_tonight: all five fixtures drift toward home, so the rule selects 5 of 5 and reduces to 'back every home side'. Yesterday it cut 6 to 4. A filter that discriminates on one slate and not the next is not yet a filter

prior_evidence.why_it_settles_nothing: break-even at a .55 ask is a 56.7% strike. The interval spans it, so the rule is neither established nor refused at n=17
prior_evidence.last_slate: 6 of 6 home sides won — one observation of a home sweep

what_would_move_this: roughly 40 more settled home legs at these prices before the interval narrows enough to exclude break-even in either direction. At 5-6 fixtures a slate that is 7-8 more slates, and it accrues whether or not any position is taken
honest_caveats: the read contributed nothing to this rule and dissented on two fixtures yesterday, losing both arguments
the drift component rests on r=+0.488, permutation p=0.109, n=12 — not significant, with two clean counterexamples
a 70.6% home strike rate is far above football's typical ~45%, which is itself a reason to suspect the sample rather than celebrate it
the corpus holds only fixtures with an admissible pre-kickoff read, so it is not a random sample of the competition
